$comment: Public release records, newest first. scripts/check-dist.mjs enforces: an installer link needs an https URL, a SHA-256 and a notices page; a "gpl" engine build also needs a corresponding-source URL. Engine "gpl" = the third-party mpv/FFmpeg build with GPL parts (0.1.0); "lgpl" = our own LGPL build (ADR 0003, option B).

notes: Redesigned player: a Full or Compact control bar (Compact is a small bar centred at the bottom), switched with one button or C.
